item.description: Renowned actor and singer Fazlur Rahman Babu has undergone a successful open-heart surgery after suffering a heart attack earlier this month.According to sources, the actor was admitted to a hospital in Dhaka after experiencing a cardiac episode on February 16. item.title: Oil shipping rates hit all-time high
item.description: The cost of chartering a supertanker to transport oil from the Middle East to China has reached an all-time high of over $400,000, according to data from the London Stock Exchange Group.This record rate applies to the largest oil-carrying vessels, capable of transporting up to 2 million barrels of crude oil.The cost is nearly double what it was last week, when the US had threatened military action against Iran.

item.title: US Embassy in Pakistan suspends all visa appointments
item.description: The US Embassy in Islamabad on Tuesday said that it will be suspending all visa appointments till March 6 (Friday) amid escalating tensions in West Asia.The announcement comes as Pakistan witnesses large-scale protests over the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and the Iran conflict. item.title: Qatar extends validity of visas by one month
item.description: The Qatar government has decided to extend the validity of all entry visas by one month, according to an official statement issued on Tuesday (March 3).In a statement, the Ministry of Interior of Qatar announced that the extension will apply to all types of entry visas. The measure took effect from February 28 and may be extended further depending on the evolving situation.The ministry said the visa extension process will be carried out automatically through the electronic system. item.title: PM postpones Bogura visit ahead of by-election
item.description: Ahead of the upcoming by-election in Bogura-6 (Sadar) constituency, Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's scheduled visit to Bogura to attend a family card distribution programme has been postponed.The Bogura district administration confirmed this on Tuesday (March 3).The Prime Minister was expected to participate in the event on March 10 in Sadar upazila.
